newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Spot Saudi riyal steady, some deposit rates up.
newsitem.headline: Spot Saudi riyal steady, some deposit rates up.

text.p: The spot Saudi riyal was flat against the dollar this week in very active trade focused on the forward market while some riyal interbank deposit rates rose 1/16, dealers in the kingdom said on Thursday.
"The market was very active. It focused on the forward market," one Riyadh-based dealer said.
The spot riyal was unchanged at 3.7506/08 to the dollar.
One-month deposit rates were 1/16 higher at 5-7/8, 3/4 percent. Similarly, three-month funds were up at six, 5-7/8.
Six-month interbank rates were steady at 6-1/16, 5-15/16 percent and one-year funds were stable at 6-5/16, 3/16 percent.
